ownLimitedSummary: A supported sufficiently direct threat to the EU budget can meet the condition without proven loss. Notifications, comments and remedy assessment precede a Commission proposal and Council decision. Measures must be proportionate. Payment obligations to eligible beneficiaries remain unless the decision provides otherwise. High debt does not supply the required budget link.
